svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: jev-pilot in a Claude Code session
svg.desc: An illustrative session. A rename runs at low effort: the pilot thinks, writes, and its bubble says low, no skill, 99% sure. A failing-tests prompt starts at xhigh effort with the systematic-debugging skill: the pilot reads, searches and runs the tests; after two failures the effort is raised to max and it flies; it writes the fix, the tests pass, and it jumps rope. Jev never writes in the conversation.
svg.text: ❯ rename userCount to activeUsers in src/stats.ts
❯ the checkout tests fail since the merge and I can't see why
● Fixed: the discount was applied twice after the merge.
